connector.name: Oro Intel MCP
connector.registryDescription: UK public procurement data for AI agents: tenders, contracts, buyer and supplier profiles.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.oro-intel.com over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the oro-intel account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional for headless use: 'Bearer oro_<key>' from https://app.oro-intel.com/dashboard/developers. Interactive clients can use OAuth sign-in instead.
